_about: Locked sprite looks for the Retro Bowl sprite card art. Keyed by league player name. skin: pale|light|tan|medium|brown|deep. hair.style: bald|buzz|short|curly|twists|afro|freeform|mohawk|spiky|dreads|shortlocs|braids|long. hair.color: black|darkbrown|brown|auburn|strawberry|blond|dirtyblond|bleached|grey or #hex. facial: none|stubble|jawline|shortbeard|mustache|goatee|chinstrap|beard|fullbeard. accessories: durag|visor|visor-gold|eyeblack|earrings|headband|sleeve-white|sleeve-black|sleeve-team|wristbands|gloves-white|gloves-black|tattoos|armbands. Optional: eyes intense, build normal|big|huge, height normal|tall, pose (any key from the Art lab's Poses strip, e.g. qb-windup, rb-stiffarm, cel-flex, sig-crossed), signature true for owner-requested showcase poses, image (a file in public/data/sprites/ that replaces the generated sprite). Built into public/data/sprites.json by scripts/build_league_data.py.

Rondale Ikarras.notes: Short black hair, full beard, studs in both ears (IMG_6201). "The Prodigal Son". Signature pose (owner): hands up in reverence, helmet off, black durag with tails, looking at the camera (owner: the eyes-up stare was freaky) [IMG_6200–6203 (game Hall of Fame)]. Face (owner): the good-looking, proportioned reference face: a triangle (cheekbones tapering to the chin), a little wider at the lower cheeks, jaw and chin so he reads human and handsome; clean defined jawline, straight nose

Sherman Brandson.notes: Fred Warner style: a high-top of short twisted locs standing up and back from the crown, falling over the shoulders; short stubble beard on a strong jaw; huge and 6'7", muscular V-taper (not fat). Signature (owner): arms crossed, menacing, helmet off [IMG_6206 + IMG_6201]. Face (owner): chiseled, triangular: wide cheekbones tapering to a strong, narrower pointed chin and a defined jawline. Locs (owner): the detailed crown of thick two-tone loc strands (twist glints, lighter tips) falling round the face to the jaw and neck, but not as big on top (a lower crown); nothing hangs behind. Jaw (owner): pushed out 1 px each side, ending a row higher in a blunter chin (the point was too sharp); cheekbones, brow and eyes unchanged. Beard (owner): a beard that does not hang: the stubble a little darker and denser, a close-cropped beard
